verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API platform like MX, but the evidence documents no batch or bulk endpoint, bulk dashboard action, or multi-item operation. MX's automatic aggregation of each member roughly every 24 hours is a platform-run recurring schedule, not a user-initiated bulk operation, so it earns no credit. User lookup in the Client Dashboard is explicitly single-user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
